title: Taking money out of my account after paying for a year subscription...
body:
Paid for a yearly subscription (discounted apparently) and have still been charged weekly...!? I have sent an email and am waiting for a response. Please resolve this.

Update - after seeing a response to my initial review (months later) I reached out to the email they suggested only to be told that I may have accidentally selected the weekly subscription and that there is no way for them to verify that. 

The first payment that came out of my account was for $31.63 for what was supposed to be a discounted YEARLY subscription. I was then charged $11.85 weekly until Jan 20th (only noticed when logging in to pay bills). A total of $79.03 has been paid to this company for a subscription I didn’t even receive and instead of correcting it they will blame you for not catching it. So beware before you set this app to any subscription payments in your account.

Also, Apple wont do anything about it as it is more than 60 days past the last payment date.

I would give this app negative stars if it were possible.

title: Please refund and I’ll update my review
body:
So I downloaded the app and decided to cancel that same day (3 days free trial before charging you) I went to cancel in my suscriptions and it wasn’t showing there. I check in my App Store suscriptions and it wasn’t there either so I proceed to delete it. Today I got charged…. Just emailed customer support and I expect they get back to me….

Update. I wish I could give a lower review than 1 star…. I was never able to access the plan I paid for, customer service “tried” to help me but it was useless… I was never able to access my plan.

Finally when requesting a refund I was told I had to pruebe I used the app at least during 7 days, maybe I would give it a try if only I was able to access “my account” but certainly I am not paying a new plan only to try it out.

Short long story: I won’t get a refund, neither access to the plan I paid for. Waste of time and money. Buyer be aware, do not even try the free trial because you will be charged a whole month even if you don’t have access to it.

title: Ad Misleading and Scammy Charges
body: One of the worst apps I’ve ever downloaded. If there were an option for negative stars, I would have chosen that. After downloading the app, I signed up and paid for a month and then a pop-up offer for one year promised 50% off so I caved. Scammy scammy, I was charged for BOTH the one-month AND the one year (and I have not been able to find a contact page or contact info anywhere to report this). Beyond that, the app is nothing like the Facebook ad; it has you creating challenges, which would be fine except there are no prompts for the challenges beyond finger-tracing a checkmark. Then it’s just nothing but a band telling you that you have a challenge. In order to gain access to the checklists like in the Facebook ad, you have to pay MORE money for them. Shame on you, developers, for your sketchy, useless app. Where can I ask for a refund?
